_comment: Live remote config for the Zolio app (formerly Folio). Fetched by RemoteConfigService once per launch, throttled by a 1h cache TTL (internal builds bypass it); falls back to the bundled assets/config/app_config.json. A successful fetch REPLACES the bundled config wholesale, so every key the app reads must be present here. Keep in sync with apps/folio/assets/config/app_config.json. This file stays named folio-app.json: installed builds fetch that exact URL.
